knobs.note: Read by bin/rule-miner.sh as ${RULE_MINER_BODY_MAX:-60000}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.
Read by bin/rule-miner.sh as ${RULE_MINER_DRY:-0}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/rule-miner-digest.sh (unset = 40): how many recurring families the digest keeps, top N by count. A set value that is not a positive integer is refused with rc 2, never clamped. Registered by BH-1749.0, applied since BH-1749.1.

Read by bin/rule-miner-digest.sh (unset = 40000): the digest.md cap, tokens = bytes/4; what does not fit is counted on its INCOMPLETE line and left out of ids-out. A set value that is not a positive integer is refused with rc 2, never clamped. Registered by BH-1749.0, applied since BH-1749.1.

Read by bin/rule-miner.sh as ${CONTEXT_BUDGETS:-$HARNESS/catalog/context-budgets.json}: the catalog the pre-call ceiling gate (BH-1764) reads the rule-miner lane's ceiling_tokens from. Empty means that path under $HARNESS; the registry default is left empty because a $HARNESS path is not a value env/global.env can copy. An unreadable file, a missing lane or a non-integer ceiling refuses the run (fail closed). NOT settable from the control plane: it is a path and a test seam, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.

Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call, so a cliff or a failure on the standing lane cannot descend into one that costs ~100x (#1141, the $793 descent).

Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend — never from the box's own logs/cost.csv. A second, project-scoped ceiling is the lane.<id>.<project>.llm_usd_cap_day row, which is read only when somebody wrote it.
